Response toolbar supports clipboard copy when available, browser speech playback when available, local feedback and share fallback
demo_notice: Version 8.0 is an offline front-end recreation of visible flows in the user-supplied recordings. App installation and connector consent affect only local demo state; external provider OAuth, APIs, real permissions and connected accounts are not implemented. Camera and Photos use browser/device file picker inputs and depend on browser/Android support. Files screen stores and attaches file metadata only; binary file contents are not uploaded. Search, Thinking, Deep research, Study and Think harder are local UI mode previews only. Hidden reasoning is never displayed. Unknown app metadata and skill text remain not supplied / not verified.
